title: Juicy Mediterranean Tomato Stir-fry
description: This fermented and juicy Malaysian dish combines the mediterranean-friendly flavors of tomatoes with a touch of chilli for a nostalgic twist.
instructions: Prepare the tomatoes by washing them and cutting into wedges.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add red chilli flakes to the garlic and stir well for another 30 seconds.
Fold in chopped thyme leaves and continue stirring for another 30 seconds.
Gently add tomato wedges into the pan without overcrowding. Let them cook for a few minutes until slightly softened, then reduce heat to low-medium and cover with a lid.
Cook on medium-low heat for about 15-20 minutes or until tomatoes are tender and most of their moisture has been absorbed.
Serve hot as a side dish or over rice. Garnish with additional thyme leaves if desired.
